indicator_name: Finished Goods Price Diffusion Index (NBK Enterprise Survey)
description: Индекс диффузии цен на готовую продукцию (опрос предприятий НБ РК)
methodology: Diffusion index (0-100, 50=neutral). NBK enterprise monitoring survey, economy-wide ('All sectors') aggregate of enterprises' reported change in their own FINISHED GOODS prices over the quarter -- an output-price/pass-through inflation gauge. History back to 2005-Q2.
